t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnomes are split into 2 groups - Earthy colours and non earthyAt any one point, each group gives more points, this will change during the game

vb_textbox.text: Gnomes appear to be split into two groups. Purple, pink red and orange as one group, all other colours are another group.Most of the time the purple, pink, red and orange group gained me more points, but at other times, they switched. Overall i got quite a few points just picking purple, pink, red and orange whenever they came up.
